newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends flat in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends flat in dull market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka edged up from an earlier level in yet another dull session of interbank trade, closing flat at 42.5470/5490 to the dollar, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5475/5495 per dollar in early trade, but gained later on poor dollar demand.
"It was a quiet day mostly due to weekend closure of international financial markets. Major players were absent," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates ended at 5.0 percent to 6.0, up from Saturday's 4.5-5.5 percent, because of the central bank's Treasury bill auction last week, dealers said.
